ProfilersCreateCases.Name: Profilers create cases
ProfilersCreateCases.Hint: When enabled, profilers can create new cases. By default only the GM creates cases.

ShowSetupWarning.Name: Warn about player permissions
ShowSetupWarning.Hint: When the GM logs in, show which players cannot create board cards on their own and can only use the board while a GM is online.

FindAnimation.Name: Discovery animation
FindAnimation.Hint: Show a found or received clue in the middle of the screen. Each user sets this for themselves.

Profilers.Name: Profilers
Profilers.Label: Choose profilers
Profilers.Hint: A profiler is a player who keeps cases and suspect dossiers. The role applies to the whole world; there can be several profilers.

Permissions.Name: Player permissions on the board
Permissions.Label: Check permissions
Permissions.Hint: Show which players can create board cards without a GM.

ZoneLabels.Name: Zone labels for the GM
ZoneLabels.Hint: Each search zone shows the clue name, the check and the DC above it. Only the GM sees them.

StampFolder.Name: Stamp folder
StampFolder.Hint: Stamps for the “Stamp” menu on board cards come from this folder. Put your own images there: white .webp files with transparency — the color is applied when stamping. After adding files, pick the folder again or reload the world.

StampColor.Name: Stamp color
StampColor.Hint: The color stamps are applied in. The “Redacted” stamp is always dark.

AutoScale.Name: Board: automatic scale
AutoScale.Hint: Size cards to the scene width. The multiplier below is then applied on top.

SceneScale.Name: Board: card scale
SceneScale.Hint: A fixed scale (without auto scale) or an overall multiplier (with auto scale).

ThreadWidth.Name: Board: thread width
ThreadWidth.Hint: Width of the threads between cards, in pixels.

BaseFontSize.Name: Board: base font size
BaseFontSize.Hint: Text size on a card of standard width.

Notify.GameMasterRequired: This action needs a GM online.
Notify.WrongSystem: Detective Story Reverse only works with the dnd5e system.

ClueTypes.Name: Name
ClueTypes.IconHint: Pick a file or upload your own through the file picker.
ClueTypes.Hint: Built-in types cannot be deleted. Your own types can be added, edited and deleted: clues of a deleted type show as “No type”.

Zone.Hint: This tile becomes a search zone: players click it to find a clue.
Zone.TemplateHint: Picking a clue fills in its detection settings below; here you can change them for this zone only.
Zone.HiddenWarning: Do not hide the zone with the standard “Hide” button: players cannot click a hidden tile. Players don't see the zone outside focus mode anyway.
Zone.RequiresHint: The zone exists for a player only once they have all of these clues (a chain). Until then it isn't highlighted and clicking it does nothing.

Detection.ZoneModeHint: Background — click the zone without a token. Battle map — a selected character token within the radius is required.
Detection.RadiusHint: Distance from the token center to the nearest edge of the zone.
Detection.CheckHint: A dnd5e skill or ability key (prc, inv, wis) or a roll formula, for example 1d20 + @abilities.int.mod.
Detection.DifficultyHint: A number or a formula. Not shown to players.

Search.TooFar: You are too far away: move ≈ {distance} {units} closer.
Search.AlreadySearched: You have already examined this place.
Search.NoActor: Assign a character in your player settings or select your token.
Search.InvalidFormula: The zone settings contain an invalid check. Tell the GM.

Chat.LevelStudyFailed: {player} studies “{clue}”: level {level} not opened ({total} vs DC {dc}).

ClueList.Title: Clue list
ClueList.NoPlayers: There are no players in the world.

ClueView.Title: Clue
ClueView.Missing: This clue is no longer in the list.
ClueView.NotesPlaceholder: Only you can see your notes. When you hand over the clue, they go with it.

Editor.Title: Clue: {name}
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.DetectionHint: Default settings: when a zone is created they are copied to it and can be changed there.
Editor.CopyHint: This is a player's copy of the clue: editing changes only this copy, not the template or other players' copies.

Visual.KindHint: Decides which card appears on the board when a player places the clue on the board.
Visual.ImageHint: If empty, the clue image is used.
Visual.TextHint: If empty, the clue name is used (the description for an index card).
Visual.PreviewHint: This is how the card will look on the board.

Grant.DragHint: Drag onto a player to give the clue
Grant.OnlyPlayers: Clues can only be given to players.

Transfer.PickHint: Tick the players. Each gets their own copy and decides whether to accept it.
Transfer.Sent: Clues sent. The recipient will see the request when they are online.
Transfer.NoRecipients: Nobody to hand over to: there are no other players.
Transfer.DuplicateHint: Clues you already have will not be added again.
Transfer.Question: Accept?

GameMasterWindow.Title: GM window
GameMasterWindow.SelectPlayer: Pick a player on the left.
GameMasterWindow.ResetForAll: Reset for all players in this zone

Library.DeleteConfirm: Delete the template “{name}”? Copies already given to players will stay.

DataTools.Conflicts: Entries whose id already exists: {count}. Replace or skip them?
DataTools.ResetWarning: All clue types, templates, suspects and cases will be deleted. This cannot be undone — export first.
DataTools.ResetPlayers: Also clear players' clues, notes and attempts

Errors.InvalidJson: The file cannot be read as JSON.
Errors.WrongFormat: This is not a Detective Story Reverse export file.
Errors.NewerVersion: The file was made by a newer version of the module.

Case.Title: Title
Case.CloseConfirm: Close the case? Pinned clues cannot be edited or deleted while the case is closed.
Case.NoClues: The case has none of your clues.
Case.DropHint: Drag a clue or a folder here from the clue list
Case.PinOnlyOwn: You can only pin a clue from your own list.
Case.ClueLocked: The clue is locked by a closed case.
Case.ArchiveHint: Closed cases. Pick a case to open or reopen it.
Case.ClosedReadOnly: The case is closed: reopen it first to change it.
Case.NoMembers: No members set — every player sees the case.

Suspect.Name: Name
Suspect.ArchivedNote: The dossier was deleted. This is a snapshot taken at deletion, kept in the case.
Suspect.DeleteArchiveNote: The suspect is linked to cases: {cases}. A snapshot of the dossier stays in them.
Suspect.ShelvedNote: This dossier is archived: hidden from lists, not deleted.

Timeline.Title: Timeline
Timeline.DragHint: Drag an event along the scale to change its time. Drop a clue from the clue list on the scale to create a new event.
Timeline.EndHint: The end is optional: with it the event is shown as an interval.
Timeline.VisibilityHint: “By clue”: players who have at least one of the checked clues see the event.
Timeline.NoCaseClues: No clues are pinned to the case.

Permissions.Title: Player permissions on the board
Permissions.Intro: These players cannot create board cards themselves: their cards are created through the GM, so this only works while a GM is online.
Permissions.AllGood: All players can create board cards without a GM.
Permissions.HowToFix: Role permissions are set in “Game Settings → Configure Permissions”.
Permissions.Disabled: Warning turned off. You can turn it back on in the module settings.

Board.CannotConnectSelf: A card cannot be connected to itself.
Board.OnlyGameMasterDeletes: Only the GM can delete cards.
Board.DeleteConfirm: Delete the card from the board?
Board.RemoveThreadsConfirm: Remove all threads of this card (incoming and outgoing)?
Board.NoDetails: This card has no linked clue.
Board.ThreadColorHint: New threads you draw will have this color.

CardPreview.Title: Card view
CardPreview.NoAudio: No audio file is attached to the cassette.
CardPreview.NoVideo: No video file is attached to the cassette.

EventLog.Title: Event log
EventLog.ClearConfirm: Delete all log entries of all participants? Clues and cases are not affected.

Stamps.FolderUnreadable: Could not read the stamp folder. Check the path in the module settings.

VideoPlayer.Title: Video recording
VideoPlayer.Muted: The browser started the video muted — turn the sound on in the player.

ClueFolders.Name: Name
ClueFolders.IconImageHint: If an image is chosen, it replaces the icon from the set.
ClueFolders.TransferEmpty: The folder has no clues: nothing to hand over.
ClueFolders.TransferOffer: Folder “{name}”, clues: {count}. It can only be accepted as a whole.

MoveDenied.cycle: A folder can't be put inside itself or its subfolder.
MoveDenied.depth: Folders can be at most {depth} levels deep.

ClueFolders.TooDeep: Folders can be at most {depth} levels deep.
ClueFolders.DeleteContents: The folder “{name}” is not empty: {clues} clues, {folders} subfolders. What should be done?
ClueFolders.DeleteZonesWarning: These templates are used by search zones on scenes ({count} zones). After deletion those zones stop working.
ClueFolders.DeleteFolderOnly: Delete only the folder, move its contents one level up
ClueFolders.DeleteWithClues: Delete the folder with its clues
ClueFolders.DeleteWithUnpin: Delete the folder and unpin its clues from the case
ClueFolders.DeleteWithTemplates: Delete the folder with its templates
ClueFolders.LockedKept: Clues of a closed case were not deleted and moved one level up: {count}.
ClueFolders.CaseOnlyFromList: Only folders from the clue list can be moved into a case.
ClueFolders.RightClickHint: Right-click a folder for subfolder, edit, delete. Drag the panel edge to resize.

Theories.Title: Theories
Theories.NoSolution: No solution set. Set one to see how theories match it.
Theories.RevealTextHint: Text players will see when you reveal the solution.
Theories.Submitted: The theory was sent to the GM.
Theories.CloseConfirm: Close the case? Reveal the solution to players now? It can also be revealed later from the theories window of the closed case.
Theories.RevealConfirm: Reveal the solution to all players? A window opens for everyone online, and a chat message stays for the rest.

Progress.Title: Progress
Progress.ProfilerHint: Only clues already found by some player are shown.
Progress.Empty: The case has no clues yet. Press “Case clues” to link library folders or templates.
Progress.NothingFound: Players haven't found anything for this case yet.
Progress.SourcesHint: The case includes templates from the checked folders (with subfolders), the checked templates and clues already pinned to the case.

Levels.EditorHint: Level 1 is the clue description, open right away. Levels 2–6 are opened by the GM or by the player with “Study” (a check against the level's difficulty).
Levels.LevelOneHint: The description from the “Summary” tab. A player gets it open as soon as they receive the clue.
Levels.HoldersHint: Tick the players who have this clue.
Levels.NoExtraLevels: The clue has a single level.
Levels.PlayerHint: Checked levels are open for the player.
